page.layout: One page of text in a single main column with a diagram-like brace structure inset in the text; a narrow marginal column of partial text on the right edge (cut off, from the facing page), which is show-through or edge of neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Running head at top: left "De specialibus in iustitia." and right "Liber 5.". Page number 148 at top centre.

main_text.l: Δυνατῶν officium est τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν δυνάτῶν ἐαστάξειν.Rom.15.1.
Hoc autem fit {Si recte assumantur. Rom.14 /
Si libertate in ἀδιάφο- 1.13. 14. /
ροις recte vtamur. 15.16.}
Recte assumuntur, qui non ad certamina διαλο-
γισμῶν, id est, contentiosas disputationes, vt pro
ni- hilo habiti, tristitia afficiuntur, sed ad pacem vt ædifi-
centur assumpti sunt. ver.1.2.
Libertatis vsus rectus est, cum in his Christo
seruimus, & proximo indulgemus ad bonum in
ædificatione.Rom.14.17.& 15.1.2.
Indulgetur autem, si gratia ipsius, cum necesse sit,
a licitis abstineamus.Rom.15.1.2.1.Cor.11.28.29.
Necesse autem est,
cum ex illorū vsu
frater infirmus vel {destruatur. alio inde malo afficiatur. Rom. 14.15.}
Destruitur autem, cum conscientia adhuc nulla
ex ea parte imbuta fide, tamen exemplo ad ea vten-
da animata poluitur, 1.Cor.8.10.11.
Alia inde orta {grauius. leuius.
Rom.14.21.} mala sunt
Grauius est προσκόμμα, quod est cum consci-
entia infirma vulneretur, & tanquam telis transfiga-
tur talium vsu. Rom.14 15.12.1.Cor.8.12.
Leuius est {σκάνδαλον. ἀσθενεία inde orta. Rom.14.21.}
Σκάνδαλον est, cum ex horum vsu, leuiter, gra-
uetur infirmi conscientia. 1.Cor.8.12.13.
Ἀσθένεια, cum infirmior in pietate & perseue-
rantia

page.notes: Right margin partially cut off; fragments of the facing page are not transcribed. Greek passages and the bracketed diagram are transcribed as closely as legible; some Greek accents are uncertain.
